patterns: APPSC pairs a traveller with one fact: 300 ports (Abdur Razzak in the Group-2 key), traveller-ruler pairs (Nuniz-Achyuta, Razzak-Devaraya II).
Andhra-centred society/economy terms recur: Vipravinodins = Brahmin jugglers for Brahmins; Porumamilla = 12 tank rules; Vasavi seat = Penugonda.
Distractor sets reuse other Andhra inscriptions (Tummalagudem, Korlagallu, Bitragunta).
Traps: Penugonda (W. Godavari) vs Penukonda; Conti is Italian, Nuniz Portuguese.
App adds many multi-statement items on coins, festivals, temple economy that go beyond PYQ depth but are mostly sound.
